content.text:
Yes, the v0.2 draft codebook was already scored on all five sources (earnings-call windows, analyst questions, both Hacker News sets and Wikipedia), so nothing needed scoring. Its wording is still the unapproved draft.

The build now works that way, and the first built deck is waiting for your review, uncommitted. Run `uv run scripts/build_edition.py --codebook v0.2-draft` and it:

- **refuses to run** unless every step in the compute graph is up to date and every file it reads is committed and unmodified;
- **builds every risk chart and number from one codebook version**. The analyst-question chart uses its own question codebook, and the stamp records both;
- **fills every number in the slide captions from the tables**. A hand-typed number fails the build. It caught one on its first run ("before 2023"), and I made that a setting;
- **checks the two paper quotes** against the finalized paper at `1afb042`;
- **writes `DECK.md`, three charts and `deck/STAMP.json`** (source commit, codebook, data hashes, tool versions, every number used, every file hash). Rebuilding gives identical files, and `--check` confirms it;
- **never commits.** `git diff` is your review, and your commit is the approval.

The built deck, rendered and checked, has eight slides:
1. Title, stamped with the commit and "v0.2-draft (DRAFT)".
2. The paper's argument, in two quotes checked against the paper.
3. AI as a risk on calls: 12.2% of 2026 calls, against at most 0.6% in any year before 2023. That's under v0.2, against 12.3% under v0.1.
4. Which risks firms named: 137 firms. Cybersecurity was named by 40, safety/ethics by 31, overspending by 26. Loss of control, new in v0.2, was named by 16.
5. What analysts ask: revenue 21.2%, controls 0.8%.
6. Who talks about which risks: safety/ethics is 10% of executives' AI-risk passages, 39% on HN about Anthropic and 61% on Wikipedia.
7. CVEs: Claude is credited on 370, and AI systems on 924.
8. What the deck does not show.

Your review will show three changes from the hand-made deck:
- **The paper's four charts are gone.** `docs/figures/` was never committed (it's another session's work), and a build can't rely on uncommitted files.
- **The executives-vs-HN comparison is dropped.** The five-source chart already covers it, under the same codebook.
- **Edits now go in `deck/deck.template.md`.** `DECK.md` is generated and says so at the top.

While wiring this up I found the captions rounded Wikipedia's 60.5% to 60% while the chart showed 61%. Both now compute from the same counts.

The v0.2 wording, including `bio_chem`, which is known to fail, still needs your review before the "DRAFT" label can come off.
Can you put extremely tight controls around the display and mangling of information?

By "display and mangling" I take you to mean the ways a number can be changed between the table and the slide: rounding a value that was already rounded, ties rounded differently in different places, a caption and a chart disagreeing, hand-typed figures, clipped labels, quotes drifting from the source. That is what bit us with the 60% caption against the 61% chart. Checking how the charts the deck reuses format their numbers.

    union = " UNION ALL ".join(f"SELECT '{h}' AS intent, count(*) FILTER (WHERE {h}) AS n FROM q WHERE {ttm}" for h in hyps)
    tsv(con, f"""SELECT intent, n AS questions, round(100.0 * n / {n_ttm}, 2) AS pct_of_ai_questions FROM ({union})
            ORDER BY n DESC, intent""", REPORT / "ttm.tsv",
        f"12 months to {as_of}: {n_ttm} AI questions from {n_analysts} questioners on {n_firms} S&P 500 firms. "
        "A question can carry several intents. Witness proposals, no gold set.")

    flags = " || ".join(f"CASE WHEN {h} THEN '{h};' ELSE '' END" for h in OVERSIGHT)
    con.execute(f"""COPY (SELECT report_date, symbol, speaker, rtrim({flags}, ';') AS oversight_intents,
            w_oversight AS oversight_words, question_id, replace(replace(text, chr(10), ' '), chr(9), ' ') AS question
        FROM q WHERE oversight ORDER BY report_date DESC, symbol, question_id)
        TO '{REPORT / 'oversight-questions.tsv'}' (HEADER, DELIMITER '\t')""")

    rows = con.execute(f"SELECT intent, questions, pct_of_ai_questions FROM read_csv('{REPORT / 'ttm.tsv'}', "
                       "comment='#', delim='\t', header=true)").fetchall()
    plot(rows, n_ttm, as_of)
    print(open(REPORT / "ttm.tsv").read())
    return 0


def plot(rows: list[tuple], n: int, as_of: str) -> None:
    import matplotlib
    matplotlib.use("svg")
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    plt.rcParams.update({"svg.hashsalt": "ec-questions", "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 10})
    group = {h: ("oversight" if h in OVERSIGHT else "commercial" if h in COMMERCIAL + ["q_spend"] else "other")
             for h, _, _ in rows}
    color = {"commercial": S1, "oversight": S2, "other": MUTED}
    shown = rows[::-1]
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 0.42 * len(shown) + 1.6), facecolor=SURFACE)
    ax.set_facecolor(SURFACE)
    ax.barh([LABELS[h] for h, _, _ in shown], [p for _, _, p in shown], color=[color[group[h]] for h, _, _ in shown],
            height=0.62)
    for i, (h, k, p) in enumerate(shown):
        ax.text(p + 0.3, i, f"{p:.1f}%  ({k})", va="center", color=INK, fontsize=9)
    for s in ("top", "right", "bottom"):
        ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["left"].set_color(INK2)
    ax.set_xticks([])
    ax.tick_params(length=0, labelsize=9.5, labelcolor=INK)
    from matplotlib.patches import Patch
    ax.legend(handles=[Patch(color=S1, label="Selling it / spending on it"), Patch(color=S2, label="Governing its risks"),
                       Patch(color=MUTED, label="Other")], loc="lower right", frameon=False, fontsize=9, labelcolor=INK)
    ax.set_title("What analysts ask S&P 500 companies about AI", loc="left", color=INK, fontsize=12,
                 fontweight="bold", pad=20)
    ax.text(0, 1.01, f"Share of {n:,} analyst questions on AI, 12 months to {as_of}",
            transform=ax.transAxes, color=INK2, fontsize=9)
    fig.text(0.01, 0.01, "A question can count under several topics. Both NLI models must agree; not hand-verified. "
             "Source: defeatbeta/yahoo-finance-data (ODC-BY).", color=INK2, fontsize=7.5)
    fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.03, 1, 1))
    fig.savefig(REPORT / "intent-ttm.svg", facecolor=SURFACE, metadata={"Date": None, "Creator": None})
    plt.close(fig)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env -S uv run --script
# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.11,<3.13"
# dependencies = [
#   "blake3==1.0.11",
#   "duckdb==2.0.0",
#   "matplotlib==3.10.7",
# ]
# ///
"""Build DECK.md as an edition of one source commit and one risk codebook.

    uv run scripts/build_edition.py --codebook v0.2-draft          # write DECK.md, deck/*.svg, deck/STAMP.json
    uv run scripts/build_edition.py --codebook v0.2-draft --check  # exit 1 if a rebuild would change anything

The build is the review step: it writes into the working tree and never commits.
Review `git diff`, then commit the edition yourself.

Preconditions (fail closed):
  - every dag.yml step is `ok` (Praxis dag.py status);
  - every input is committed and unmodified.

Display controls (docs/report-build.md; every one fails the build):
  1. Exact inputs. Every number shown is computed from integer counts by
     scripts/display.py: no float, and no rounded table column, is ever shown.
  2. One rounding rule: half up, from the exact fraction.
  3. One source per number. Every chart in the deck is drawn here, from the
     same registered values as the captions, so chart and caption cannot disagree.
  4. Provenance. Every displayed value is registered with its source file,
     computation, numerator and denominator, and written to the stamp.
  5. No unbound numerals. The template may contain no digits outside {{...}}
     (front matter excepted). Every numeral in the built DECK.md, and in every
     chart's text (axis tick labels excepted), must be a registered value.
  6. Quotes. Text in double quotes in the template must be a single quote
     binding, and every quote binding must occur verbatim in edition v0.
  7. Nothing clipped. Every text element of a matplotlib chart lies inside the
     figure. Every SVG parses as XML.
  8. One codebook. Every risk chart and number uses the --codebook given.
Positive = DeBERTa and ModernBERT both >= 0.5, everywhere.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from fractions import Fraction
from html import escape
from pathlib import Path

import blake3
import duckdb

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import display  # noqa: E402

TEMPLATE = ROOT / "deck" / "deck.template.md"
OUT_DIR = ROOT / "deck"
EC = ROOT / "corpus" / "earnings-calls"
PAPER, PAPER_V0 = "docs/anthropic-contrapunctus.md", "1afb042"
DAG_TOOL = ROOT.parent / "praxis" / "datasets" / "dag.py"
FIRST_YEAR, CUTOFF_YEAR, TTM_MONTHS = 2013, 2023, 12
RISK_WORD = r"(?i)\brisk(s|y|ier|iest)?\b"
THRESHOLD = Fraction(1, 2)

CODEBOOKS = {
    "v0.2-draft": {
        "file": "corpus/codebooks/codebook-v0.2-draft.tsv",
        "ec_scores": "proposals/earnings-calls/codebook-v0.2-draft",
        "dialogue": "proposals/cross-source/codebook-v0.2-draft/report/dialogue-space.tsv",
        "status": " (DRAFT: wording awaits review)",
    },
}
QUESTIONS = {"codebook": "v0.1", "file": "corpus/earnings-calls/codebook-questions-v0.1.tsv",
             "ttm": "proposals/earnings-calls/codebook-questions-v0.1/report/ttm.tsv"}
CVE = "corpus/cve/monthly-ai.tsv"
QUOTES = {  # binding -> exact text in edition v0 (markdown emphasis and line breaks removed before matching)
    "q_toothless": "Anthropic's charter is legally real and legally toothless.",
    "q_365b": "§365(b) gives directors no duty to any person on account of a public-benefit interest",
    "q_33k": "33,000+",
}
STATIC_TOKENS = {"500"}   # "S&P 500" is a name, not a quantity
DIALOGUE_SOURCES = [("executives", "Executives (calls)"), ("analysts", "Analyst questions"),
                    ("hn_anthropic", "HN: Anthropic"), ("hn_security", "HN: AI security"), ("wikipedia", "Wikipedia")]
LABELS = {"regulation": "Regulation", "cyber": "Cybersecurity", "privacy": "Data privacy",
          "accuracy": "Accuracy / hallucination", "bias": "Bias / fairness", "labor": "Jobs / labor",
          "disruption": "Disruption of the business", "capex": "Overspending / capex return",
          "energy": "Energy / power", "supply": "Chip & supply constraints", "ip": "Intellectual property",
          "safety_ethics": "Safety / ethics / misuse"}
SURFACE, INK, INK2, GRID = "#fcfcfb", "#0b0b0b", "#52514e", "#e4e3df"
S1, S2, MUTED = "#2a78d6", "#eb6834", "#a8a69f"
META = {"Date": None, "Creator": None}

NUM = re.compile(r"\b(?=[0-9a-f]*[a-f])(?=[0-9a-f]*\d)[0-9a-f]{7,40}\b"   # commit ids
                 r"|\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}|\d{4}-\d{2}"                         # dates, months
                 r"|v\d+(?:\.\d+)+(?:-draft)?"                             # versions
                 r"|§\d+\([a-z]\)"                                         # statute sections
                 r"|\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?\+?")                                # numbers


def tokens(s: str) -> set[str]:
    return {m.group(0).rstrip(",") for m in NUM.finditer(s)}


def git(*a: str) -> str:
    return subprocess.run(["git", *a], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout


def b3(p: Path) -> str:
    return blake3.blake3(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def table(path: str) -> tuple[list[str], list[dict]]:
    with (ROOT / path).open() as f:
        lines = f.read().splitlines()
    comments = [l for l in lines if l.startswith("#")]
    return comments, list(csv.DictReader([l for l in lines if not l.startswith("#")], delimiter="\t"))


class Build:
    def __init__(self, codebook: str) -> None:
        self.codebook, self.cb = codebook, CODEBOOKS[codebook]
        self.reg = display.Registry()
        self.errs: list[str] = []
        self.outs: dict[str, bytes] = {}

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ preconditions
    def inputs(self) -> list[str]:
        return [self.cb["file"], self.cb["ec_scores"], self.cb["dialogue"], QUESTIONS["file"], QUESTIONS["ttm"], CVE,
                "corpus/earnings-calls/calls.tsv", "corpus/earnings-calls/ai-windows.parquet",
                "deck/deck.template.md", "scripts/build_edition.py", "scripts/display.py", "dag.lock.tsv"]

    def preflight(self) -> bool:
        r = subprocess.run(["uv", "run", "--quiet", str(DAG_TOOL), "status"], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True)
        if r.returncode != 0:
            self.errs.append("dag.py status is not all ok:\n" + "\n".join(
                l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if not l.startswith("ok")))
        for p in self.inputs():
            if not git("ls-files", "--", p).strip():
                self.errs.append(f"input not committed: {p}")
        dirty = git("status", "--porcelain", "--", *self.inputs()).strip()
        if dirty:
            self.errs.append("inputs modified since the last commit:\n" + dirty)
        return not self.errs

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ checks
    def allowed(self) -> set[str]:
        out = set(STATIC_TOKENS)
        for t in self.reg.texts():
            out |= tokens(t)
        return out

    def check_text(self, where: str, s: str) -> None:
        bad = sorted(tokens(s) - self.allowed())
        if bad:
            self.errs.append(f"{where}: unregistered numerals {bad} in {s[:90]!r}")

    def save_fig(self, fig, name: str) -> None:
        import matplotlib
        fig.canvas.draw()
        r = fig.canvas.get_renderer()
        box = fig.bbox
        ticks = set()
        for ax in fig.axes:
            ticks |= set(ax.get_xticklabels()) | set(ax.get_yticklabels())
        for t in fig.findobj(matplotlib.text.Text):
            s = t.get_text()
            if not t.get_visible() or not s.strip():
                continue
            bb = t.get_window_extent(r)
            if bb.x0 < box.x0 - 0.5 or bb.y0 < box.y0 - 0.5 or bb.x1 > box.x1 + 0.5 or bb.y1 > box.y1 + 0.5:
                self.errs.append(f"{name}: text clipped at the figure edge: {s[:60]!r}")
            if t not in ticks:
                self.check_text(name, s)
        path = OUT_DIR / name
        fig.savefig(path, facecolor=SURFACE, metadata=META)
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
        plt.close(fig)
        self.outs[f"deck/{name}"] = path.read_bytes()

    def save_svg(self, svg: str, name: str) -> None:
        root = ET.fromstring(svg)
        for el in root.iter():
            if el.tag.split("}")[-1] in ("text", "title", "desc") and el.text:
                self.check_text(name, el.text)
        path = OUT_DIR / name
        path.write_text(svg)
        self.outs[f"deck/{name}"] = path.read_bytes()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ values
    def register_static(self, head: str) -> None:
        R = self.reg
        R.put("codebook", self.codebook, source=self.cb["file"], how="--codebook")
        R.put("codebook_status", self.cb["status"], source="build_edition.CODEBOOKS", how="status of the codebook")
        R.put("question_codebook", QUESTIONS["codebook"], source=QUESTIONS["file"], how="question-intent codebook")
        R.put("source_commit", head[:12], source="git", how="HEAD at build time")
        R.put("paper_v0", PAPER_V0, source="git", how="edition v0 commit of the paper")
        R.put("threshold", display.round_half_up(THRESHOLD, 1), source="build_edition.THRESHOLD", how="both witnesses >= this")
        R.put("ttm_months", str(TTM_MONTHS), source="build_edition.TTM_MONTHS", how="trailing window, months")
        R.put("ec_cutoff_year", str(CUTOFF_YEAR), source="build_edition.CUTOFF_YEAR", how="comparison year")
        new = {r["status"].split()[0] for r in table(self.cb["file"])[1] if r["status"].startswith("v0.2")}
        for i, v in enumerate(sorted(new)):
            R.put(f"new_tag_{i}", v, source=self.cb["file"], how="status column of hypotheses new in this codebook")
        text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", git("show", f"{PAPER_V0}:{PAPER}").replace("**", "").replace("*", ""))
        for k, q in QUOTES.items():
            if q not in text:
                self.errs.append(f"quote {k} not found verbatim in {PAPER}@{PAPER_V0}: {q!r}")
            R.put(k, q, source=f"{PAPER}@{PAPER_V0}", how="verbatim quote (emphasis and line breaks removed)")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ earnings calls
    def earnings(self) -> None:
        R, cb = self.reg, self.cb
        scores = ROOT / cb["ec_scores"]
        con = duckdb.connect()
        as_of = str(con.execute(f"SELECT max(report_date) FROM read_csv('{EC / 'calls.tsv'}')").fetchone()[0])
        R.put("as_of", as_of, source="corpus/earnings-calls/calls.tsv", how="max(report_date)")

        def flags(h: str) -> str:
            return (f"SELECT d.window_id FROM '{scores / 'deberta.parquet'}' d JOIN '{scores / 'modernbert.parquet'}' m "
                    f"USING (window_id, hypothesis_id) WHERE d.hypothesis_id = '{h}' "
                    f"AND d.p_entail >= {float(THRESHOLD)} AND m.p_entail >= {float(THRESHOLD)}")
        types = [r["id"] for r in table(cb["file"])[1] if r["group"] == "risk_type"]
        new = {r["id"] for r in table(cb["file"])[1] if r["status"].startswith("v0.2")}
        con.execute(f"""CREATE TABLE calls AS SELECT symbol, fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, report_date
            FROM read_csv('{EC / "calls.tsv"}')
            WHERE (duplicate_of IS NULL OR duplicate_of = '') AND n_paragraphs > 2 AND report_date <= DATE '{as_of}'""")
        con.execute(f"""CREATE TABLE w AS SELECT window_id, symbol, fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter,
                report_date::DATE AS report_date, regexp_matches(text, '{RISK_WORD}') AS lex,
                window_id IN ({flags('ai_risk')}) AS ai_risk
            FROM '{EC / "ai-windows.parquet"}'""")
        con.execute("""CREATE TABLE cw AS SELECT c.*, bool_or(w.lex) AS lex, bool_or(w.ai_risk) AS nli
            FROM calls c LEFT JOIN w USING (symbol, fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter) GROUP BY ALL""")
        series = con.execute(f"""SELECT year(report_date)::INT, count(*)::INT,
                (count(*) FILTER (WHERE lex))::INT, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE nli))::INT
            FROM cw WHERE year(report_date) >= {FIRST_YEAR} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1""").fetchall()
        src = f"corpus/earnings-calls/{{calls.tsv,ai-windows.parquet}} + {cb['ec_scores']}"
        for y, n, lex, nli in series:
            R.pct(f"ec_lex_{y}", lex, n, 1, source=src, how=f"{y}: calls with a 'risk' word in an AI window / calls")
            R.pct(f"ec_nli_{y}", nli, n, 1, source=src, how=f"{y}: calls with an ai_risk window (both witnesses) / calls")
        last = series[-1]
        R.put("ec_year_last", str(last[0]), source=src, how="last calendar year in the series")
        R.put("ec_pct_witness_last", R.values[f"ec_nli_{last[0]}"]["text"], source=src, how="= ec_nli_<last year>")
        pre = max((r for r in series if r[0] < CUTOFF_YEAR), key=lambda r: Fraction(r[3], r[1]))
        R.put("ec_pre2023_max", R.values[f"ec_nli_{pre[0]}"]["text"], source=src,
              how=f"max over years < {CUTOFF_YEAR} of ec_nli_<year> (attained {pre[0]})")

        since = f"DATE '{as_of}' - INTERVAL {TTM_MONTHS} MONTH"
        con.execute(f"CREATE TABLE ttm AS SELECT * FROM w WHERE report_date > {since} AND report_date <= DATE '{as_of}' AND ai_risk")
        ranking = []
        for t in types:
            firms = con.execute(f"SELECT count(DISTINCT symbol)::INT FROM ttm WHERE window_id IN ({flags(t)})").fetchone()[0]
            lab = LABELS.get(t, t) + (" *" if t in new else "")
            ranking.append((t, lab, firms))
            R.count(f"ec_rank_{t}", firms, source=src, how=f"firms with a window both ai_risk and {t}, trailing window")
        ranking.sort(key=lambda r: (-r[2], r[0]))
        R.count("ec_ttm_risk_firms", con.execute("SELECT count(DISTINCT symbol)::INT FROM ttm").fetchone()[0],
                source=src, how="firms with >= 1 ai_risk window, trailing window")
        R.put("ec_top3", ", ".join(f"{LABELS.get(r[0], r[0])} ({R.values[f'ec_rank_{r[0]}']['text']})" for r in ranking[:3]),
              source=src, how="top three of the ranking")
        self.plot_series(series)
        self.plot_ranking(ranking)

    def mpl(self):
        import matplotlib
        matplotlib.use("svg")
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
        plt.rcParams.update({"svg.hashsalt": "edition", "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 10,
                             "axes.edgecolor": INK2, "axes.labelcolor": INK2, "xtick.color": INK2, "ytick.color": INK2})
        return matplotlib, plt

    @staticmethod
    def style(ax) -> None:
        ax.set_facecolor(SURFACE)
        ax.grid(axis="y", color=GRID, lw=0.8)
        ax.set_axisbelow(True)
        for s in ("top", "right", "left"):
            ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
        ax.tick_params(length=0)

    def plot_series(self, series) -> None:
        R = self.reg
        matplotlib, plt = self.mpl()
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.4), facecolor=SURFACE)
        self.style(ax)
        years = [r[0] for r in series]
        for key, col, color, name in (("lex", 2, S1, 'Mentions "risk" next to AI (no model)'),
                                      ("nli", 3, S2, f"Both models: AI framed as a risk ({self.codebook})")):
            ys = [float(Fraction(100 * r[col], r[1])) for r in series]   # positions only; labels are registered text
            ax.plot(years, ys, color=color, lw=2, marker="o", ms=4.5, mec=SURFACE, mew=1.5, label=name)
            ax.annotate(R.values[f"ec_{key}_{years[-1]}"]["text"] + "%", (years[-1], ys[-1]), xytext=(8, 0),
                        textcoords="offset points", va="center", color=INK, fontsize=10, fontweight="bold")
        ax.set_xticks(years, [str(y) if y != years[-1] else f"{y}\n(to {R.values['as_of']['text'][5:]})" for y in years],
                      fontsize=9)
        ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(matplotlib.ticker.FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f"{v:.0f}%"))
        ax.set_ylim(0, None)
        ax.set_xlim(years[0] - 0.5, years[-1] + 1.2)
        ax.set_title("Share of S&P 500 earnings calls where AI is discussed as a risk", loc="left",
                     color=INK, fontsize=12, fontweight="bold", pad=22)
        ax.text(0, 1.02, "Calls per calendar year; denominator: every unique, non-stub S&P 500 call in the corpus",
                transform=ax.transAxes, color=INK2, fontsize=9)
        ax.legend(loc="upper left", frameon=False, fontsize=9, labelcolor=INK)
        fig.text(0.01, 0.01, f"Source: defeatbeta/yahoo-finance-data transcripts (ODC-BY). Model line: risk codebook "
                 f"{self.codebook}; witness proposal, not hand-verified.", color=INK2, fontsize=7.5)
        fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.03, 1, 1))
        self.save_fig(fig, "ai-risk-by-year.svg")

    def plot_ranking(self, ranking) -> None:
        R = self.reg
        matplotlib, plt = self.mpl()
        shown = [r for r in ranking if r[2] > 0][::-1]
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 0.36 * len(shown) + 1.6), facecolor=SURFACE)
        ax.set_facecolor(SURFACE)
        ax.barh([r[1] for r in shown], [r[2] for r in shown], color=S1, height=0.62)
        for i, r in enumerate(shown):
            ax.text(r[2] + 0.4, i, R.values[f"ec_rank_{r[0]}"]["text"], va="center", color=INK, fontsize=9)
        for s in ("top", "right", "bottom"):
            ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
        ax.set_xticks([])
        ax.tick_params(length=0, labelsize=9.5, labelcolor=INK)
        ax.set_title(f"AI risks raised on S&P 500 calls, {TTM_MONTHS} months to {R.values['as_of']['text']}",
                     loc="left", color=INK, fontsize=12, fontweight="bold", pad=30)
        ax.text(0, 1.01, f"Number of companies; both models must propose the window.\nRisk codebook {self.codebook}; "
                f"* = new in {R.values['new_tag_0']['text']}.", transform=ax.transAxes, color=INK2, fontsize=8.5)
        fig.tight_layout()
        self.save_fig(fig, "risk-ranking-ttm.svg")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ analyst questions
    def questions(self) -> None:
        R = self.reg
        comments, rows = table(QUESTIONS["ttm"])
        m = re.fullmatch(r"# (\d+) months to (\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}): (\d+) AI questions from .*", comments[0])
        if not m or int(m.group(1)) != TTM_MONTHS or m.group(2) != R.values["as_of"]["text"]:
            self.errs.append(f"{QUESTIONS['ttm']}: header does not state {TTM_MONTHS} months to the same as-of: {comments[:1]}")
            return
        n_q = int(m.group(3))
        R.count("q_n", n_q, source=QUESTIONS["ttm"], how="AI questions in the trailing window (header)")
        import ec_question_report as qr
        out = []
        for r in rows:
            k = int(r["questions"])
            p = R.pct(f"q_{r['intent'][2:]}_pct", k, n_q, 1, source=QUESTIONS["ttm"], how=f"questions with {r['intent']} / q_n")
            R.count(f"q_{r['intent'][2:]}_n", k, source=QUESTIONS["ttm"], how=f"questions with {r['intent']}")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ cross-source dialogue space
    def dialogue(self) -> None:

        for r in types:
            for k, _ in DIALOGUE_SOURCES:
                n = int(r[f"{k}_n"])
                R.pct(f"ds_{k}_{r['risk_type']}", n, bases[k], 0, source=cb["dialogue"], how=f"{k}: {r['risk_type']} / AI-risk units")
                R.pct(f"ds1_{k}_{r['risk_type']}", n, bases[k], 1, source=cb["dialogue"], how="same, one decimal (tooltip)")
                R.count(f"dsn_{k}_{r['risk_type']}", n, source=cb["dialogue"], how=f"{k}: {r['risk_type']} units")
        for key, (src, t) in {"ds_exec_safety": ("executives", "safety_ethics"), "ds_hn_safety": ("hn_anthropic", "safety_ethics"),
                              "ds_wp_safety": ("wikipedia", "safety_ethics"), "ds_sec_cyber": ("hn_security", "cyber")}.items():
            R.put(key, R.values[f"ds_{src}_{t}"]["text"], source=cb["dialogue"], how=f"= ds_{src}_{t}")
        rows_sorted = sorted(types, key=lambda r: (-max(Fraction(int(r[f'{k}_n']), bases[k]) for k, _ in DIALOGUE_SOURCES),

        cw, rh, left, top = 128, 24, 210, 108

        def fill(n: int, d: int) -> str:

        o = [f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 {W} {H}" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" role="img">',

             f'Risk codebook {escape(self.codebook)}; * = new in {R.values["new_tag_0"]["text"]}.</text>']
        for j, (k, label) in enumerate(DIALOGUE_SOURCES):

        for i, r in enumerate(rows_sorted):

            o.append(f'<text x="{left - 8}" y="{y + rh / 2 + 4}" font-size="12" text-anchor="end">{escape(t)}{" *" if t in new else ""}</text>')
            for j, (k, label) in enumerate(DIALOGUE_SOURCES):
                n, d = int(r[f"{k}_n"]), bases[k]

                         f'({R.values[f"dsn_{k}_{t}"]["text"]} of {R.values[f"ds_base_{k}"]["text"]})</title>'
                         f'<rect x="{left + j * cw + 1}" y="{y + 1}" width="{cw - 2}" height="{rh - 2}" rx="2" fill="{fill(n, d)}"/>'
                         f'<text x="{left + j * cw + cw / 2}" y="{y + rh / 2 + 4}" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" style="fill:{ink}">{txt}</text></g>')
        o.append(f'<text x="16" y="{H - 30}" font-size="11" class="m">n = passages both NLI witnesses score ≥ '
                 f'{R.values["threshold"]["text"]} on ai_risk; a cell needs both on the type too. A passage can name several types.</text>')
        o.append(f'<text x="16" y="{H - 14}" font-size="11" class="m">Windows as in {escape(cb["dialogue"])}. '
                 'Witness proposals, no gold set.</text>')

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ CVE
    def cve(self) -> None:

        _, rows = table(CVE)
        R.count("cve_claude_total", sum(int(r["n_credit_claude"]) for r in rows), source=CVE, how="sum n_credit_claude, all months")
        R.count("cve_ai_total", sum(int(r["n_ai_credited"]) for r in rows), source=CVE, how="sum n_ai_credited, all months")

        R.put("cve_last", rows[-1]["month"], source=CVE, how="last month")
        r = [x for x in rows if x["month"] >= "2023-01"]
        R.put("cve_chart_first", r[0]["month"], source=CVE, how="first month charted")
        months = [x["month"] for x in r]
        pub = [int(x["n_published"]) for x in r]
        ai = [int(x["n_ai_credited"]) for x in r]
        claude = [int(x["n_credit_claude"]) for x in r]
        R.count("cve_last_pub", pub[-1], source=CVE, how="n_published, last month")
        R.count("cve_last_ai", ai[-1], source=CVE, how="n_ai_credited, last month")
        R.count("cve_last_claude", claude[-1], source=CVE, how="n_credit_claude, last month")
        matplotlib, plt = self.mpl()
        xs = range(len(months))

        fig, (a1, a2) = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(9, 6.2), facecolor=SURFACE, sharex=True, gridspec_kw={"hspace": 0.45})
        self.style(a1)
        a1.bar(xs, pub, color=S1, width=0.78)
        a1.annotate(R.values["cve_last_pub"]["text"], (xs[-1], pub[-1]), xytext=(-2, 4), textcoords="offset points",
                    ha="right", color=INK, fontsize=9, fontweight="bold")
        a1.yaxis.set_major_formatter(matplotlib.ticker.FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f"{v:,.0f}"))
        a1.set_title("CVEs published per month", loc="left", color=INK, fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")
        self.style(a2)
        a2.bar(xs, claude, color=S2, width=0.78, label="Credit names Claude")
        a2.bar(xs, [a - c for a, c in zip(ai, claude)], bottom=claude, color=MUTED, width=0.78,
               label="Credit names another AI system or term")
        a2.annotate(f"{R.values['cve_last_ai']['text']} ({R.values['cve_last_claude']['text']} Claude)", (xs[-1], ai[-1]),
                    xytext=(-4, 4), textcoords="offset points", ha="right", color=INK, fontsize=9, fontweight="bold")
        a2.set_title("CVEs whose credits name an AI system, per month", loc="left", color=INK, fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")
        a2.legend(loc="upper left", frameon=False, fontsize=9, labelcolor=INK)
        a2.set_xticks(ticks, [months[i][:4] for i in ticks])

                     color=INK, fontsize=13, fontweight="bold")
        fig.text(0.01, 0.01, f"Source: CVEProject/cvelistV5 baseline {R.values['as_of']['text']} (corpus/cve), "
                 f"{R.values['cve_chart_first']['text']} to {R.values['cve_last']['text']}.\n"
                 "Credit = the CNA credits field only, matched to named AI systems. Method credit: Epoch AI (CC BY).",
                 color=INK2, fontsize=7)
        fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.08, right=0.98, top=0.88, bottom=0.12)
        self.save_fig(fig, "cve-ai-credit.svg")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ deck
    def render(self, head: str) -> None:
        tpl = TEMPLATE.read_text()
        fm_end = tpl.index("\n---\n", 4) + 5
        body = tpl[fm_end:]
        for i, line in enumerate(body.splitlines(), tpl[:fm_end].count("\n") + 1):
            bare = re.sub(r"\{\{\w+\}\}", "", re.sub(r"<!--.*?-->", "", line))
            bare = re.sub(r"!\[[^\]]*\]\([^)]*\)", "", bare)   # image directives (w:900) are layout, not data
            bad = sorted(tokens(bare) - STATIC_TOKENS)
            if bad:
                self.errs.append(f"deck.template.md:{i}: hand-typed numerals {bad}")
            for q in re.findall(r'"([^"]*)"', re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", "", line)):
                if not re.fullmatch(r"\{\{q_\w+\}\}", q):
                    self.errs.append(f"deck.template.md:{i}: quoted text must be one quote binding: \"{q}\"")
        self.reg.put("generated_notice", f"<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build_edition.py --codebook {self.codebook} from {head}. "
                     "Edit deck/deck.template.md, not this file. -->", source="build", how="notice")
        vals = {k: v["text"] for k, v in self.reg.values.items()}
        missing = sorted(set(re.findall(r"\{\{(\w+)\}\}", tpl)) - set(vals))
        self.errs += [f"unresolved binding {{{{{m}}}}}" for m in missing]
        md = re.sub(r"\{\{(\w+)\}\}", lambda m: vals.get(m.group(1), m.group(0)), tpl)
        out_body = re.sub(r"<!--.*?-->", "", md[md.index("\n---\n", 4) + 5:], flags=re.S)
        out_body = re.sub(r"!\[[^\]]*\]\([^)]*\)", "", out_body)
        self.check_text("DECK.md", out_body)
        self.outs["DECK.md"] = md.encode()

    def run(self) -> tuple[dict[str, bytes], list[str]]:
        display.selftest()
        if not self.preflight():
            return {}, self.errs
        head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD").strip()
        OUT_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        self.register_static(head)
        self.earnings()
        self.questions()
        self.dialogue()
        self.cve()
        self.render(head)
        stamp = {
            "edition_of": head,
            "codebook": {"risk": self.codebook, "risk_file": self.cb["file"], "risk_blake3": b3(ROOT / self.cb["file"]),
                         "question_intents": QUESTIONS["file"]},
            "rule": f"positive = DeBERTa and ModernBERT both >= {self.reg.values['threshold']['text']}",
            "rounding": "half up from the exact fraction of integer counts (scripts/display.py)",
            "dag_lock_blake3": b3(ROOT / "dag.lock.tsv"),
            "paper_v0": f"{PAPER}@{PAPER_V0}",
            "tools": {"python": "duckdb==2.0.0 matplotlib==3.10.7 blake3==1.0.11",
                      "render": "npx @marp-team/marp-cli@4.1.2 DECK.md --pptx --allow-local-files"},
            "values": {k: v for k, v in sorted(self.reg.values.items()) if k != "generated_notice"},
            "inputs": {p: b3(ROOT / p) for p in sorted(self.inputs()) if (ROOT / p).is_file()},
            "outputs": {k: blake3.blake3(v).hexdigest() for k, v in sorted(self.outs.items())},
        }
        self.outs["deck/STAMP.json"] = (json.dumps(stamp, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n").encode()
        return self.outs, self.errs


OUTPUTS = ["DECK.md", "deck/STAMP.json", "deck/ai-risk-by-year.svg", "deck/risk-ranking-ttm.svg",
           "deck/intent-ttm.svg", "deck/dialogue-space.svg", "deck/cve-ai-credit.svg"]


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--codebook", required=True, choices=sorted(CODEBOOKS))
    ap.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="rebuild and compare; leave the tree unchanged")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    before = {p: (ROOT / p).read_bytes() for p in OUTPUTS if (ROOT / p).exists()}

    def restore() -> None:
        for p in OUTPUTS:
            if p in before:
                (ROOT / p).write_bytes(before[p])
            elif (ROOT / p).exists():
                (ROOT / p).unlink()
    outs, errs = Build(a.codebook).run()
    if errs:
        restore()
        print("build failed:\n  " + "\n  ".join(errs), file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    if a.check:
        diff = sorted(p for p in OUTPUTS if before.get(p) != outs.get(p))
        restore()
        print("edition is current" if not diff else "edition would change: " + ", ".join(diff))
        return 1 if diff else 0
    for p, v in outs.items():
        (ROOT / p).write_bytes(v)
    print(f"built edition of {json.loads(outs['deck/STAMP.json'])['edition_of'][:12]} with risk codebook "
          f"{a.codebook}. Review `git diff`, then commit.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env -S uv run --script
# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.11,<3.13"
# dependencies = [
#   "blake3==1.0.11",
#   "duckdb==2.0.0",
#   "matplotlib==3.10.7",
# ]
# ///
"""Build DECK.md as an edition of one source commit and one risk codebook.

    uv run scripts/build_edition.py --codebook v0.2-draft          # write DECK.md, deck/*.svg, deck/STAMP.json
    uv run scripts/build_edition.py --codebook v0.2-draft --check  # exit 1 if a rebuild would change anything

The build is the review step: it writes into the working tree and never commits.
Review `git diff`, then commit the edition yourself.

Preconditions (fail closed):
  - every dag.yml step is `ok` (Praxis dag.py status);
  - every input is committed and unmodified.

Display controls (docs/report-build.md; every one fails the build):
  1. Exact inputs. Every number shown is computed from integer counts by
     scripts/display.py: no float, and no rounded table column, is ever shown.
  2. One rounding rule: half up, from the exact fraction.
  3. One source per number. Every chart in the deck is drawn here, from the
     same registered values as the captions, so chart and caption cannot disagree.
  4. Provenance. Every displayed value is registered with its source file,
     computation, numerator and denominator, and written to the stamp.
  5. No unbound numerals. The template may contain no digits outside {{...}}
     (front matter excepted). Every numeral in the built DECK.md, and in every
     chart's text (axis tick labels excepted), must be a registered value.
  6. Quotes. Text in double quotes in the template must be a single quote
     binding, and every quote binding must occur verbatim in edition v0.
  7. Nothing clipped. Every text element of a matplotlib chart lies inside the
     figure. Every SVG parses as XML.
  8. One codebook. Every risk chart and number uses the --codebook given.
Positive = DeBERTa and ModernBERT both >= 0.5, everywhere.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from fractions import Fraction
from html import escape
from pathlib import Path

import blake3
import duckdb

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import display  # noqa: E402

TEMPLATE = ROOT / "deck" / "deck.template.md"
OUT_DIR = ROOT / "deck"
EC = ROOT / "corpus" / "earnings-calls"
PAPER, PAPER_V0 = "docs/anthropic-contrapunctus.md", "1afb042"
DAG_TOOL = ROOT.parent / "praxis" / "datasets" / "dag.py"
FIRST_YEAR, CUTOFF_YEAR, TTM_MONTHS = 2013, 2023, 12
RISK_WORD = r"(?i)\brisk(s|y|ier|iest)?\b"
THRESHOLD = Fraction(1, 2)

CODEBOOKS = {
    "v0.2-draft": {
        "file": "corpus/codebooks/codebook-v0.2-draft.tsv",
        "ec_scores": "proposals/earnings-calls/codebook-v0.2-draft",
        "dialogue": "proposals/cross-source/codebook-v0.2-draft/report/dialogue-space.tsv",
        "status": " (DRAFT: wording awaits review)",
    },
}
QUESTIONS = {"codebook": "v0.1", "file": "corpus/earnings-calls/codebook-questions-v0.1.tsv",
             "ttm": "proposals/earnings-calls/codebook-questions-v0.1/report/ttm.tsv"}
CVE = "corpus/cve/monthly-ai.tsv"
QUOTES = {  # binding -> exact text in edition v0 (markdown emphasis and line breaks removed before matching)
    "q_toothless": "Anthropic's charter is legally real and legally toothless.",
    "q_365b": "§365(b) gives directors no duty to any person on account of a public-benefit interest",
    "q_33k": "33,000+",
}
STATIC_TOKENS = {"500"}   # "S&P 500" is a name, not a quantity
DIALOGUE_SOURCES = [("executives", "Executives (calls)"), ("analysts", "Analyst questions"),
                    ("hn_anthropic", "HN: Anthropic"), ("hn_security", "HN: AI security"), ("wikipedia", "Wikipedia")]
LABELS = {"regulation": "Regulation", "cyber": "Cybersecurity", "privacy": "Data privacy",
          "accuracy": "Accuracy / hallucination", "bias": "Bias / fairness", "labor": "Jobs / labor",
          "disruption": "Disruption of the business", "capex": "Overspending / capex return",
          "energy": "Energy / power", "supply": "Chip & supply constraints", "ip": "Intellectual property",
          "safety_ethics": "Safety / ethics / misuse"}
SURFACE, INK, INK2, GRID = "#fcfcfb", "#0b0b0b", "#52514e", "#e4e3df"
S1, S2, MUTED = "#2a78d6", "#eb6834", "#a8a69f"
META = {"Date": None, "Creator": None}

NUM = re.compile(r"\b(?=[0-9a-f]*[a-f])(?=[0-9a-f]*\d)[0-9a-f]{7,40}\b"   # commit ids
                 r"|\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}|\d{4}-\d{2}"                         # dates, months
                 r"|v\d+(?:\.\d+)+(?:-draft)?"                             # versions
                 r"|§\d+\([a-z]\)"                                         # statute sections
                 r"|\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?\+?")                                # numbers


def tokens(s: str) -> set[str]:
    return {m.group(0).rstrip(",") for m in NUM.finditer(s)}


def git(*a: str) -> str:
    return subprocess.run(["git", *a], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout


def b3(p: Path) -> str:
    return blake3.blake3(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def table(path: str) -> tuple[list[str], list[dict]]:
    with (ROOT / path).open() as f:
        lines = f.read().splitlines()
    comments = [l for l in lines if l.startswith("#")]
    return comments, list(csv.DictReader([l for l in lines if not l.startswith("#")], delimiter="\t"))


class Build:
    def __init__(self, codebook: str) -> None:
        self.codebook, self.cb = codebook, CODEBOOKS[codebook]
        self.reg = display.Registry()
        self.errs: list[str] = []
        self.outs: dict[str, bytes] = {}

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ preconditions
    def inputs(self) -> list[str]:
        return [self.cb["file"], self.cb["ec_scores"], self.cb["dialogue"], QUESTIONS["file"], QUESTIONS["ttm"], CVE,
                "corpus/earnings-calls/calls.tsv", "corpus/earnings-calls/ai-windows.parquet",
                "deck/deck.template.md", "scripts/build_edition.py", "scripts/display.py",
                "scripts/ec_question_report.py", "dag.lock.tsv"]

    def preflight(self) -> bool:
        r = subprocess.run(["uv", "run", "--quiet", str(DAG_TOOL), "status"], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True)
        if r.returncode != 0:
            self.errs.append("dag.py status is not all ok:\n" + "\n".join(
                l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if not l.startswith("ok")))
        for p in self.inputs():
            if not git("ls-files", "--", p).strip():
                self.errs.append(f"input not committed: {p}")
        dirty = git("status", "--porcelain", "--", *self.inputs()).strip()
        if dirty:
            self.errs.append("inputs modified since the last commit:\n" + dirty)
        return not self.errs

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ checks
    def allowed(self) -> set[str]:
        out = set(STATIC_TOKENS)
        for t in self.reg.texts():
            out |= tokens(t)
        return out

    def check_text(self, where: str, s: str) -> None:
        bad = sorted(tokens(s) - self.allowed())
        if bad:
            self.errs.append(f"{where}: unregistered numerals {bad} in {s[:90]!r}")

    def save_fig(self, fig, name: str) -> None:
        import matplotlib
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
        fig.canvas.draw()
        r = fig.canvas.get_renderer()
        box = fig.bbox
        ticks = set()
        for ax in fig.axes:
            ticks |= set(ax.get_xticklabels()) | set(ax.get_yticklabels())
        for t in fig.findobj(matplotlib.text.Text):
            s = t.get_text()
            if not t.get_visible() or not s.strip():
                continue
            bb = t.get_window_extent(r)
            if bb.x0 < box.x0 - 0.5 or bb.y0 < box.y0 - 0.5 or bb.x1 > box.x1 + 0.5 or bb.y1 > box.y1 + 0.5:
                self.errs.append(f"{name}: text clipped at the figure edge: {s[:60]!r}")
            if t not in ticks:
                self.check_text(name, s)
        path = OUT_DIR / name
        fig.savefig(path, facecolor=SURFACE, metadata=META)
        plt.close(fig)
        ET.fromstring(path.read_bytes())
        self.outs[f"deck/{name}"] = path.read_bytes()

    def save_svg(self, svg: str, name: str) -> None:
        root = ET.fromstring(svg)
        for el in root.iter():
            if el.tag.split("}")[-1] in ("text", "title", "desc") and el.text:
                self.check_text(name, el.text)
        path = OUT_DIR / name
        path.write_text(svg)
        self.outs[f"deck/{name}"] = path.read_bytes()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ values
    def register_static(self, head: str) -> None:
        R = self.reg
        R.put("codebook", self.codebook, source=self.cb["file"], how="--codebook")
        R.put("codebook_status", self.cb["status"], source="build_edition.CODEBOOKS", how="status of the codebook")
        R.put("question_codebook", QUESTIONS["codebook"], source=QUESTIONS["file"], how="question-intent codebook")
        R.put("source_commit", head[:12], source="git", how="HEAD at build time")
        R.put("paper_v0", PAPER_V0, source="git", how="edition v0 commit of the paper")
        R.put("threshold", display.round_half_up(THRESHOLD, 1), source="build_edition.THRESHOLD", how="both witnesses >= this")
        R.put("ttm_months", str(TTM_MONTHS), source="build_edition.TTM_MONTHS", how="trailing window, months")
        R.put("ec_cutoff_year", str(CUTOFF_YEAR), source="build_edition.CUTOFF_YEAR", how="comparison year")
        new = {r["status"].split()[0] for r in table(self.cb["file"])[1] if r["status"].startswith("v0.2")}
        for i, v in enumerate(sorted(new)):
            R.put(f"new_tag_{i}", v, source=self.cb["file"], how="status column of hypotheses new in this codebook")
        text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", git("show", f"{PAPER_V0}:{PAPER}").replace("**", "").replace("*", ""))
        for k, q in QUOTES.items():
            if q not in text:
                self.errs.append(f"quote {k} not found verbatim in {PAPER}@{PAPER_V0}: {q!r}")
            R.put(k, q, source=f"{PAPER}@{PAPER_V0}", how="verbatim quote (emphasis and line breaks removed)")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ earnings calls
    def earnings(self) -> None:
        R, cb = self.reg, self.cb
        scores = ROOT / cb["ec_scores"]
        con = duckdb.connect()
        as_of = str(con.execute(f"SELECT max(report_date) FROM read_csv('{EC / 'calls.tsv'}')").fetchone()[0])
        R.put("as_of", as_of, source="corpus/earnings-calls/calls.tsv", how="max(report_date)")

        def flags(h: str) -> str:
            return (f"SELECT d.window_id FROM '{scores / 'deberta.parquet'}' d JOIN '{scores / 'modernbert.parquet'}' m "
                    f"USING (window_id, hypothesis_id) WHERE d.hypothesis_id = '{h}' "
                    f"AND d.p_entail >= {float(THRESHOLD)} AND m.p_entail >= {float(THRESHOLD)}")
        cbrows = table(cb["file"])[1]
        types = [r["id"] for r in cbrows if r["group"] == "risk_type"]
        new = {r["id"] for r in cbrows if r["status"].startswith("v0.2")}
        con.execute(f"""CREATE TABLE calls AS SELECT symbol, fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, report_date
            FROM read_csv('{EC / "calls.tsv"}')
            WHERE (duplicate_of IS NULL OR duplicate_of = '') AND n_paragraphs > 2 AND report_date <= DATE '{as_of}'""")
        con.execute(f"""CREATE TABLE w AS SELECT window_id, symbol, fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter,
                report_date::DATE AS report_date, regexp_matches(text, '{RISK_WORD}') AS lex,
                window_id IN ({flags('ai_risk')}) AS ai_risk
            FROM '{EC / "ai-windows.parquet"}'""")
        con.execute("""CREATE TABLE cw AS SELECT c.*, bool_or(w.lex) AS lex, bool_or(w.ai_risk) AS nli
            FROM calls c LEFT JOIN w USING (symbol, fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter) GROUP BY ALL""")
        series = con.execute(f"""SELECT year(report_date)::INT, count(*)::INT,
                (count(*) FILTER (WHERE lex))::INT, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE nli))::INT
            FROM cw WHERE year(report_date) >= {FIRST_YEAR} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1""").fetchall()
        src = f"corpus/earnings-calls/{{calls.tsv,ai-windows.parquet}} + {cb['ec_scores']}"
        for y, n, lex, nli in series:
            R.pct(f"ec_lex_{y}", lex, n, 1, source=src, how=f"{y}: calls with a 'risk' word in an AI window / calls")
            R.pct(f"ec_nli_{y}", nli, n, 1, source=src, how=f"{y}: calls with an ai_risk window (both witnesses) / calls")
        last = series[-1]
        R.put("ec_year_last", str(last[0]), source=src, how="last calendar year in the series")
        R.put("ec_pct_witness_last", R.values[f"ec_nli_{last[0]}"]["text"], source=src, how="= ec_nli_<last year>")
        pre = max((r for r in series if r[0] < CUTOFF_YEAR), key=lambda r: Fraction(r[3], r[1]))
        R.put("ec_pre2023_max", R.values[f"ec_nli_{pre[0]}"]["text"], source=src,
              how=f"max over years < {CUTOFF_YEAR} of ec_nli_<year> (attained {pre[0]})")

        since = f"DATE '{as_of}' - INTERVAL {TTM_MONTHS} MONTH"
        con.execute(f"CREATE TABLE ttm AS SELECT * FROM w WHERE report_date > {since} AND report_date <= DATE '{as_of}' AND ai_risk")
        ranking = []
        for t in types:
            firms = con.execute(f"SELECT count(DISTINCT symbol)::INT FROM ttm WHERE window_id IN ({flags(t)})").fetchone()[0]
            lab = LABELS.get(t, t) + (" *" if t in new else "")
            ranking.append((t, lab, firms))
            R.count(f"ec_rank_{t}", firms, source=src, how=f"firms with a window both ai_risk and {t}, trailing window")
        ranking.sort(key=lambda r: (-r[2], r[0]))
        R.count("ec_ttm_risk_firms", con.execute("SELECT count(DISTINCT symbol)::INT FROM ttm").fetchone()[0],
                source=src, how="firms with >= 1 ai_risk window, trailing window")
        R.put("ec_top3", ", ".join(f"{LABELS.get(r[0], r[0])} ({R.values[f'ec_rank_{r[0]}']['text']})" for r in ranking[:3]),
              source=src, how="top three of the ranking")
        self.plot_series(series)
        self.plot_ranking(ranking)

    def questions(self) -> None:

        if not m or int(m.group(1)) != TTM_MONTHS or m.group(2) != R.values["as_of"]["text"]:

            return
        n_q = int(m.group(3))

        import ec_question_report as qr

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ cross-source dialogue space
    def dialogue(self) -> None:
        R, cb = self.reg, self.cb
        _, rows = table(cb["dialogue"])
        base = next(r for r in rows if r["risk_type"] == "ai_risk_units")
        bases = {k: int(base[f"{k}_n"]) for k, _ in DIALOGUE_SOURCES}
        types = [r for r in rows if r["risk_type"] != "ai_risk_units"]
        for k, _ in DIALOGUE_SOURCES:
            R.count(f"ds_base_{k}", bases[k], source=cb["dialogue"], how=f"{k} AI-risk units")
        for r in types:
            for k, _ in DIALOGUE_SOURCES:
                n = int(r[f"{k}_n"])
                R.pct(f"ds_{k}_{r['risk_type']}", n, bases[k], 0, source=cb["dialogue"], how=f"{k}: {r['risk_type']} / AI-risk units")
                R.pct(f"ds1_{k}_{r['risk_type']}", n, bases[k], 1, source=cb["dialogue"], how="same, one decimal (tooltip)")
                R.count(f"dsn_{k}_{r['risk_type']}", n, source=cb["dialogue"], how=f"{k}: {r['risk_type']} units")
        for key, (src, t) in {"ds_exec_safety": ("executives", "safety_ethics"), "ds_hn_safety": ("hn_anthropic", "safety_ethics"),
                              "ds_wp_safety": ("wikipedia", "safety_ethics"), "ds_sec_cyber": ("hn_security", "cyber")}.items():
            R.put(key, R.values[f"ds_{src}_{t}"]["text"], source=cb["dialogue"], how=f"= ds_{src}_{t}")
        rows_sorted = sorted(types, key=lambda r: (-max(Fraction(int(r[f'{k}_n']), bases[k]) for k, _ in DIALOGUE_SOURCES),
                                                   r["risk_type"]))
        cw, rh, left, top = 128, 24, 210, 108
        W, H = left + cw * len(DIALOGUE_SOURCES) + 24, top + rh * len(rows_sorted) + 64

        def fill(n: int, d: int) -> str:
            t = min(Fraction(100 * n, d) / 50, Fraction(1))
            lo, hi = (236, 243, 249), (16, 70, 120)
            return "#%02x%02x%02x" % tuple(int(display.round_half_up(a + (b - a) * t, 0)) for a, b in zip(lo, hi))
        new = {r["risk_type"] for r in rows if r.get("new_in_v0.2") == "yes"}
        o = [f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 {W} {H}" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" role="img">',
             '<style>text{fill:#1b1b1b}.m{fill:#5f6368}</style>', f'<rect width="{W}" height="{H}" fill="{SURFACE}"/>',
             '<text x="16" y="30" font-size="18" font-weight="600">Who talks about which AI risks</text>',
             f'<text x="16" y="52" font-size="12" class="m">Share of each source\'s AI-risk passages naming each type. '
             f'Risk codebook {escape(self.codebook)}; * = new in {R.values["new_tag_0"]["text"]}.</text>']
        for j, (k, label) in enumerate(DIALOGUE_SOURCES):
            x = left + j * cw + cw / 2
            o.append(f'<text x="{x}" y="{top - 24}" font-size="12" font-weight="600" text-anchor="middle">{escape(label)}</text>')
            o.append(f'<text x="{x}" y="{top - 9}" font-size="11" class="m" text-anchor="middle">n = {R.values[f"ds_base_{k}"]["text"]}</text>')
        for i, r in enumerate(rows_sorted):
            t = r["risk_type"]
            y = top + i * rh
            o.append(f'<text x="{left - 8}" y="{y + rh / 2 + 4}" font-size="12" text-anchor="end">{escape(t)}{" *" if t in new else ""}</text>')
            for j, (k, label) in enumerate(DIALOGUE_SOURCES):
                n, d = int(r[f"{k}_n"]), bases[k]
                ink = "#ffffff" if Fraction(100 * n, d) >= 25 else "#1b1b1b"
                o.append(f'<g><title>{escape(label)}: {escape(t)} {R.values[f"ds1_{k}_{t}"]["text"]}% '
                         f'({R.values[f"dsn_{k}_{t}"]["text"]} of {R.values[f"ds_base_{k}"]["text"]})</title>'
                         f'<rect x="{left + j * cw + 1}" y="{y + 1}" width="{cw - 2}" height="{rh - 2}" rx="2" fill="{fill(n, d)}"/>'
                         f'<text x="{left + j * cw + cw / 2}" y="{y + rh / 2 + 4}" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" '
                         f'style="fill:{ink}">{R.values[f"ds_{k}_{t}"]["text"]}</text></g>')
        o.append(f'<text x="16" y="{H - 30}" font-size="11" class="m">n = passages both NLI witnesses score ≥ '
                 f'{R.values["threshold"]["text"]} on ai_risk; a cell needs both on the type too. A passage can name several types.</text>')
        o.append(f'<text x="16" y="{H - 14}" font-size="11" class="m">Windows as in {escape(cb["dialogue"])}. '
                 'Witness proposals, no gold set.</text>')
        o.append("</svg>")
        self.save_svg("\n".join(o) + "\n", "dialogue-space.svg")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ deck
    def render(self, head: str) -> None:
        tpl = TEMPLATE.read_text()
        fm_end = tpl.index("\n---\n", 4) + 5
        first = tpl[:fm_end].count("\n") + 1
        for i, line in enumerate(tpl[fm_end:].splitlines(), first):
            bare = re.sub(r"\{\{\w+\}\}", "", re.sub(r"<!--.*?-->", "", line))
            bare = re.sub(r"!\[[^\]]*\]\([^)]*\)", "", bare)   # image directives (w:900) are layout, not data
            bad = sorted(tokens(bare) - STATIC_TOKENS)
            if bad:
                self.errs.append(f"deck.template.md:{i}: hand-typed numerals {bad}")
            for q in re.findall(r'"([^"]*)"', re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", "", line)):
                if not re.fullmatch(r"\{\{q_\w+\}\}", q):
                    self.errs.append(f"deck.template.md:{i}: quoted text must be one quote binding: \"{q}\"")
        self.reg.put("generated_notice", f"<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build_edition.py --codebook {self.codebook} from {head}. "
                     "Edit deck/deck.template.md, not this file. -->", source="build", how="notice")
        vals = {k: v["text"] for k, v in self.reg.values.items()}
        missing = sorted(set(re.findall(r"\{\{(\w+)\}\}", tpl)) - set(vals))
        self.errs += [f"unresolved binding {{{{{m}}}}}" for m in missing]
        md = re.sub(r"\{\{(\w+)\}\}", lambda m: vals.get(m.group(1), m.group(0)), tpl)
        out_body = re.sub(r"<!--.*?-->", "", md[md.index("\n---\n", 4) + 5:], flags=re.S)
        out_body = re.sub(r"!\[[^\]]*\]\([^)]*\)", "", out_body)
        self.check_text("DECK.md", out_body)
        self.outs["DECK.md"] = md.encode()

    def run(self) -> tuple[dict[str, bytes], list[str]]:
        display.selftest()
        if not self.preflight():
            return {}, self.errs
        head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD").strip()
        OUT_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        self.register_static(head)
        self.earnings()
        self.questions()
        self.dialogue()
        self.cve()
        self.render(head)
        stamp = {
            "edition_of": head,
            "codebook": {"risk": self.codebook, "risk_file": self.cb["file"], "risk_blake3": b3(ROOT / self.cb["file"]),
                         "question_intents": QUESTIONS["file"]},
            "rule": f"positive = DeBERTa and ModernBERT both >= {self.reg.values['threshold']['text']}",
            "rounding": "half up from the exact fraction of integer counts (scripts/display.py)",
            "dag_lock_blake3": b3(ROOT / "dag.lock.tsv"),
            "paper_v0": f"{PAPER}@{PAPER_V0}",
            "tools": {"python": "duckdb==2.0.0 matplotlib==3.10.7 blake3==1.0.11",
                      "render": "npx @marp-team/marp-cli@4.1.2 DECK.md --pptx --allow-local-files"},
            "values": {k: v for k, v in sorted(self.reg.values.items()) if k != "generated_notice"},
            "inputs": {p: b3(ROOT / p) for p in sorted(self.inputs()) if (ROOT / p).is_file()},
            "outputs": {k: blake3.blake3(v).hexdigest() for k, v in sorted(self.outs.items())},
        }
        self.outs["deck/STAMP.json"] = (json.dumps(stamp, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n").encode()
        return self.outs, self.errs


OUTPUTS = ["DECK.md", "deck/STAMP.json", "deck/ai-risk-by-year.svg", "deck/risk-ranking-ttm.svg",
           "deck/intent-ttm.svg", "deck/dialogue-space.svg", "deck/cve-ai-credit.svg"]


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--codebook", required=True, choices=sorted(CODEBOOKS))
    ap.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="rebuild and compare; leave the tree unchanged")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    before = {p: (ROOT / p).read_bytes() for p in OUTPUTS if (ROOT / p).exists()}

    def restore() -> None:
        for p in OUTPUTS:
            if p in before:
                (ROOT / p).write_bytes(before[p])
            elif (ROOT / p).exists():
                (ROOT / p).unlink()
    outs, errs = Build(a.codebook).run()
    if errs:
        restore()
        print("build failed:\n  " + "\n  ".join(errs), file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    if a.check:
        diff = sorted(p for p in OUTPUTS if before.get(p) != outs.get(p))
        restore()
        print("edition is current" if not diff else "edition would change: " + ", ".join(diff))
        return 1 if diff else 0
    for p, v in outs.items():
        (ROOT / p).write_bytes(v)
    print(f"built edition of {json.loads(outs['deck/STAMP.json'])['edition_of'][:12]} with risk codebook "
          f"{a.codebook}. Review `git diff`, then commit.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Negative tests: each display control in build_edition.py must fail on a bad input.

    uv run scripts/test_edition_controls.py

Nothing in the repository is written: templates are temporary files, charts go to
a temporary directory.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import tempfile
from fractions import Fraction
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import build_edition as be  # noqa: E402
import display  # noqa: E402

FAILS: list[str] = []


def expect(name: str, cond: bool) -> None:
    print(("ok    " if cond else "FAIL  ") + name)
    if not cond:
        FAILS.append(name)


def raises(fn, exc) -> bool:
    try:
        fn()
    except exc:
        return True
    return False


def build_with(template: str) -> be.Build:
    b = be.Build("v0.2-draft")
    b.reg.put("as_of", "2026-11-04", source="test", how="test")
    b.reg.put("q_ok", "33,000+", source="test", how="test")
    b.reg.put("n", "137", source="test", how="test")
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w", suffix=".md", delete=False) as f:
        f.write(template)
    old = be.TEMPLATE
    be.TEMPLATE = Path(f.name)
    try:
        b.render("0" * 40)
    finally:
        be.TEMPLATE = old
    return b


FM = "---\nmarp: true\nsize: 16:9\n---\n\n"

# 1-2. exact inputs and one rounding rule
display.selftest()
expect("float input refused", raises(lambda: display.pct(0.5, 1), TypeError))
expect("rounded-column float refused", raises(lambda: display.round_half_up(60.5, 0), TypeError))
expect("half up at a tie (1/8 -> 13)", display.pct(1, 8, 0) == "13")
expect("exact fraction, not the rounded column (504/833 -> 61)", display.pct(504, 833, 0) == "61")
expect("numerator above denominator refused", raises(lambda: display.pct(9, 8), ValueError))
reg = display.Registry()
reg.put("x", "12.2", source="t", how="t")
expect("one binding cannot carry two texts", raises(lambda: reg.put("x", "12.3", source="t", how="t"), ValueError))

# 5. no unbound numerals
b = build_with(FM + "There were 42 firms.\n")
expect("hand-typed numeral in template fails", any("hand-typed numerals ['42']" in e for e in b.errs))
b = build_with(FM + "{{n}} firms in S&P 500 calls, to {{as_of}}.\n")
expect("bound numerals and the S&P 500 name pass", not b.errs)
b = build_with(FM + "Missing {{nope}}.\n")
expect("unresolved binding fails", any("unresolved binding" in e for e in b.errs))
b = be.Build("v0.2-draft")
b.check_text("chart", "peak 0.31%")
expect("unregistered numeral in chart text fails", any("unregistered numerals" in e for e in b.errs))

# 6. quotes
b = build_with(FM + 'They said "a paraphrase".\n')
expect("quoted text that is not a quote binding fails", any("quote binding" in e for e in b.errs))
b = build_with(FM + 'The headline "{{q_ok}}" stands.\n')
expect("quote binding passes", not b.errs)

# 7. clipping and XML
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    be.OUT_DIR = Path(d)
    b = be.Build("v0.2-draft")
    matplotlib, plt = b.mpl()
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4, 3))
    fig.text(0.9, 0.5, "this label runs off the right edge")
    b.save_fig(fig, "clip.svg")
    expect("text past the figure edge fails", any("clipped" in e for e in b.errs))
    expect("malformed SVG fails", raises(lambda: b.save_svg("<svg><text>a & b</text></svg>", "bad.svg"), Exception))

print(f"\n{len(FAILS)} failure(s)")
sys.exit(1 if FAILS else 0)

    def out(name: str, sql: str) -> None:
        con.execute(f"COPY ({sql}) TO '{REPORT / name}' (HEADER, DELIMITER '\t')")

    # 1. Witness agreement per hypothesis.
    out("agreement.tsv", """
      SELECT cb."group", hypothesis_id, count(*) AS n_windows,
             sum(pos_deb::INT) AS pos_deberta, sum(pos_mod::INT) AS pos_modernbert, sum(pos::INT) AS pos_both,
             round(( avg((pos_deb = pos_mod)::INT)
                     - (avg(pos_deb::INT) * avg(pos_mod::INT) + (1 - avg(pos_deb::INT)) * (1 - avg(pos_mod::INT))) )
                   / nullif(1 - (avg(pos_deb::INT) * avg(pos_mod::INT) + (1 - avg(pos_deb::INT)) * (1 - avg(pos_mod::INT))), 0), 3)
               AS cohen_kappa
      FROM s JOIN cb ON cb.id = s.hypothesis_id GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY min(cb.ord)""")

    # 2. By fiscal year, with the all-calls denominator.
    out("by-year.tsv", """
      WITH c AS (SELECT fiscal_year, count(*) AS calls FROM calls GROUP BY 1),
      k AS (SELECT fiscal_year, count(DISTINCT (symbol, fiscal_quarter)) AS calls_ai,
                   count(DISTINCT (symbol, fiscal_quarter)) FILTER (WHERE about_ai AND ai_risk) AS calls_ai_risk,

            FROM f GROUP BY 1)
      SELECT c.fiscal_year, c.calls, coalesce(calls_ai, 0) AS calls_mentioning_ai,
             coalesce(calls_ai_risk, 0) AS calls_with_ai_risk,
             round(coalesce(calls_ai_risk, 0) / c.calls, 4) AS share_calls_ai_risk,
             coalesce(calls_ai_governance, 0) AS calls_with_ai_governance,
             coalesce(windows_ai, 0) AS windows_ai, coalesce(windows_risk, 0) AS windows_risk,

      FROM c LEFT JOIN k USING (fiscal_year) ORDER BY 1""")

    # 3. Risk types by year (window counts; type and ai_risk both both-agree).

      SELECT role, count(*) FILTER (WHERE about_ai) AS windows_ai,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE about_ai AND ai_risk) AS windows_risk,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE about_ai AND ai_opportunity) AS windows_opportunity,
             round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE about_ai AND ai_risk) / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE about_ai), 0), 4) AS share_risk,
             round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE about_ai AND ai_opportunity) / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE about_ai), 0), 4) AS share_opportunity
      FROM f GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1""")

    # 5. Per firm, for the join to the Risk-Governance Index (Appendix E).
    tcols = ", ".join(f"count(*) FILTER (WHERE about_ai AND ai_risk AND {t}) AS {t}" for t in types)
    out("by-firm.tsv", f"""
      WITH c AS (SELECT symbol, count(*) AS calls FROM calls GROUP BY 1)
      SELECT c.symbol, c.calls,
             count(DISTINCT (f.fiscal_year, f.fiscal_quarter)) FILTER (WHERE about_ai) AS calls_mentioning_ai,
             min(f.fiscal_year) FILTER (WHERE about_ai) AS first_ai_fy,
             min(f.fiscal_year) FILTER (WHERE about_ai AND ai_risk) AS first_ai_risk_fy,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE about_ai) AS windows_ai,
        window_id NOT IN (SELECT window_id FROM f WHERE h IN ({spec}) AND b) AS untyped
        FROM f WHERE h = 'ai_risk' AND b""")
    con.execute(f"""COPY (SELECT h AS hypothesis, count(*) AS n_windows,
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE bd) AS n_deberta, count(*) FILTER (WHERE bm) AS n_modernbert,
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE b) AS n_both FROM f GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n_both DESC, 1)
        TO '{rep / 'hypotheses.tsv'}' (HEADER, DELIMITER '\t')""")
    con.execute(f"""COPY (SELECT title, count(*) AS n_ai_risk_windows,
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE untyped) AS n_no_specific_type,
          round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE untyped) / count(*), 1) AS pct_no_specific_type
        FROM r JOIN w USING (window_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n_no_specific_type DESC, title)
        TO '{rep / 'untyped-by-article.tsv'}' (HEADER, DELIMITER '\t')""")
    n, u = con.execute("SELECT count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE untyped) FROM r").fetchone()
    tot = con.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM w").fetchone()[0]

        f"{tot}\t{n}\t{u}\t{100 * u / n:.1f}\n")
    print(f"{tot} windows; {n} proposed ai_risk; {u} ({100 * u / n:.1f}%) with no specific risk type")

def tsv(con, sql: str, path: Path, note: str = "") -> None:
    rel = con.execute(sql)
    cols = [d[0] for d in rel.description]
    rows = rel.fetchall()
    fmt = lambda v: "" if v is None else (f"{v:.4f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".") if isinstance(v, float) else str(v))
    path.write_text((f"# {note}\n" if note else "") + "\t".join(cols) + "\n"
                    + "".join("\t".join(fmt(v) for v in r) + "\n" for r in rows))

"""Deterministic tables over the two NLI witnesses. Counts, never verdicts.

A window is a *proposed* positive for a hypothesis only when BOTH witnesses
(DeBERTa-v3-large and ModernBERT-large) score P(entailment) >= THRESHOLD.
Each witness's own count and Cohen's kappa between them are reported beside
it, so disagreement is visible rather than averaged away. Rates use the
calls.tsv denominator (unique, non-stub S&P 500 calls), never AI windows alone.

    uv run scripts/ec_report.py            # writes proposals/earnings-calls/codebook-v0.1/report/*.tsv

Speaker role is a heuristic (a speaker heard on >= 3 issuers' calls is treated
as a sell-side analyst); it is reported as such.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

import duckdb

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
CORPUS = ROOT / "corpus" / "earnings-calls"
PROP = ROOT / "proposals" / "earnings-calls" / "codebook-v0.1"
REPORT = PROP / "report"
THRESHOLD = 0.5


def main() -> int:
    for m in ("deberta", "modernbert"):

result.output:
# Open questions

Decisions and questions waiting on someone. Each has an owner, the context
needed to answer it, and what it blocks. When one is answered, move it to
**Answered** with the answer, who gave it, and the commit that acted on it.
Never delete an entry.

New questions come from the work itself and from `PASTEBIN.md`.

## Open

### Q1 · Who signs the datasets?
- **Status:** partly answered 2026-11-04. Sloane signs with her own key;
  `scripts/attest_datasets.py` builds the records. Still open: which key, the
  first signing run, and whether to sign commits.
- **Owner:** Sloane
- **Context:** Every corpus is hash-pinned and rebuilds byte-identical, but
  nothing is signed. The attestation protocol (`docs/contrapunctus-attest.md`:
  SSH Ed25519, `ssh-keygen -Y sign`, `verify.sh`) covers only the paper.
  `docs/praxis-standard.md` PS-3.7 says release signing is open because no key
  exists. Commits are unsigned.
- **Proposal:** each corpus gets a signing record (commit plus the hash of every
  output file), signed in a separate dataset namespace and checked by
  `verify.sh`. `DATASETS.md` shows the signers.
- **Options:** Sloane's key; an Ethical Capital dataset key; either one plus a
  build key. A build key proves only that this pipeline made these bytes; it
  does not mean anyone vouches for them. Separately: whether to sign commits.
- **Blocks:** the attestation part of the white paper's method for the corpora.

### Q2 · Approve the codebook v0.2 wording
- **Owner:** Sloane
- **Context:** `corpus/codebooks/codebook-v0.2-draft.tsv` keeps the 16 v0.1
  hypotheses and adds 14, each citing a Wikipedia heading and revision. The
  `democracy` item comes from the health-of-democracy question, not a heading.
  All four sources are scored against the draft so the wording can be judged
  on real output.
- **Blocks:** citing any v0.2 result; the cross-source map of who discusses
  which risks.

### Q3 · Who codes the gold sets?
- **Owner:** Sloane
- **Context:** `gold/earnings-calls/` holds two blind samples: 240 windows and
  200 analyst questions. `uv run scripts/ec_gold.py code --coder NAME` codes
  them; a second coder works on a copy (`--sample PATH`). Spec §9 bars LLM
  labels.
- **Blocks:** every rate leaving `proposals/` (spec §7, go criterion a). The
  controls category gets only a handful of positives into the sample; if it
  becomes the headline, it needs a targeted extra sample.

### Q4 · Seal version and date for the paper
----
  one witness among several, not as ground truth (`docs/corpus-roadmap.md`).

### Q12 · Regroup details
- **Owner:** Sloane
- **Context:** `docs/plan-owid-regroup.md`. The regroup and strict metadata are
  decided. Two details are not: whether `snapshots/` keeps a generated TSV
  MANIFEST beside each YAML (proposed: yes), and whether scripts split into
  per-step files now or later (proposed: later).
- **Also:** signing waits until the layout is final, because signatures taken
  before the move would go stale.

### Q13 · Where is the repository's public home?
- **Owner:** Sloane
- **Context:** Script user agents name `github.com/ethicalcapital/anthropic-pbc`;
  the git remote is `github.com/srvo/anthropic-pbc`. Metadata `url_main` and
  `url_download` for in-repo artifacts (codebooks) stay null until this is
  settled and the commits are pushed.

### Q14 · Licences of model output and of files inside corpus/
- **Owner:** Sloane
- **Context:** AGENTS.md and the README say everything is CC0 except
  `corpus/*/`. The metadata instead follows the regroup plan: a dataset's
  licence follows its most restrictive source. So HN scores are ODC-BY and

Adversarial review, dimension: METHOD AND PUBLICATION RISK. Repository: /Users/srvo/dev/anthropic-pbc (HEAD a83255b), a public CC0 research repo critiquing Anthropic PBC's governance, with corpora (S&P 500 earnings calls via the defeatbeta Hugging Face dataset, Hacker News, Wikipedia, CVE credits, Epoch AI, democracy proxies) and model "witness" labels (two NLI models; a label counts when both score ≥ 0.5) under proposals/. Review as a hostile but honest referee and as the repo's lawyer. Only committed content (`git ls-files`) plus DECK.md.
1. Method: are claims supported by the design? Witness labels presented as findings; threshold choice; no gold set; denominators and coverage reported beside rates; survivorship (today's S&P 500); partial-year comparisons; multiple comparisons/forking paths in codebook v0.2 (built from Wikipedia headings); whether "risk" detection measures what captions say. Name the single weakest inferential link in DECK.md.
2. Source terms and licences: is redistributing each committed corpus file allowed (defeatbeta/Yahoo-sourced transcript text, HN, Wikipedia CC BY-SA, CVE/MITRE terms, Epoch CC BY)? Does any committed file contain raw third-party text that the docs say is stored only as ids/hashes? Check corpus/hacker-news especially: private individuals' text must be ids and hashes only. Check licence statements are consistent across AGENTS.md, README, corpus READMEs, metadata.
3. Privacy and secrets: grep tracked files for usernames of private individuals in quotes, emails, API keys/tokens patterns (report presence + file:line only, NEVER the value), hostnames of private infrastructure.
4. Fairness: quotes from Anthropic used out of context; is the critique falsifiable as the docs claim; anything that would be defamatory or unsupported if published.

setup is the one command that makes a repository's brain useful and keeps it
that way. It runs three phases:

  1. instant   build the deterministic core (code index, sessions, seed,
               docs, history). Blocking, seconds, spends NO agent tokens. The
               brain is queryable the moment this returns.
  2. backfill  distill past sessions into durable facts, NEWEST FIRST, detached
               in the background on a cheap model. Spends tokens; bounded by
               --backfill-budget and the persisted distill cache, and skipped
               entirely when no agent CLI is available.
  3. daemon    register the repo into a workspace and install ONE machine-wide
               watcher service (launchd on macOS, a systemd user unit on Linux)
               so freshness never depends on remembering to run anything.
               ONE means one: the installed unit is identical for every repo and
               every workspace, and each workspace's interval, distill cadence,
               agent, model, effort and session cap live in a machine-level watch
               plan the running watcher re-reads. Setting up a second repo adds a
               row to that plan; it does not rewrite, restart or steal the
               watcher the first repo is relying on.

TOKEN SPEND: phases 2 and 3 call an agent. This is the first release in which
the watcher's --distill step and the session-end hook's distill actually run
(both were dead before), so setup is a real, recurring cost, bounded by five
gates: the fact phase ASKS before it spends (default no, and a run with no
terminal never spends unless --yes is passed), --backfill-budget sessions per
background pass, one gated agent run per --distill-every per repo, the
persisted distill cache (a session is never distilled twice), and the cheap
--model/--effort. Passing --no-backfill with --no-daemon spends nothing at all,
and "entire brain status" reports what the backfill has done so far and whether the
watcher is alive.

EXIT CODE: setup exits 0 whenever the brain is QUERYABLE, and queryable means
it can answer: at least one of the code index, the seed baseline or the
history index built. Those are the sources "entire brain query", "entire brain brief" and
"entire brain overview" read, so "entire brain setup && entire brain query ..." cannot proceed on a
brain that has nothing to answer from. A component that fails without costing
that (a doc index, an entity index, a stale code index beside a seed
that built) is reported as one line, skipped, and the remaining components, the
backfill, the workspace registration and the daemon install all still run;
"entire brain status" then shows that component as failed and "entire brain doctor" prints
